notes.title: The demo is available!
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]After a few weeks' work, the demo of my game "Don't Get Caught!" is finally available on Steam. [/p][p][/p][p]This first demo (lasting around 10 minutes) covers the tutorial as well as the first real level, and gives a glimpse of some of the game's innovative mechanics. I'd be delighted if you played it, and especially if you gave me some feedback afterwards.[/p]

notes.title: Playtest #1
notes.notes:
A first build is available! This is a technical playtest

As integration with Steam is not yet complete, the demo is currently only available on the itch.io page.

I hope to be able to make progress on Steam integration during April, so that Playtest n°2 will be available everywhere.
